Omar: heads up — spike in mtls rejects from apac yesterday ~23:50Z. seeing clients drop connections with "bad certificate" across a few frontends. digging.
Tess: which frontends? any common certchain?
Omar: edge-cdn-apac, auth-gateway-apac, telemetry-proxy. sample log: 
```
2026-03-24T23:49:57Z edge-cdn-apac warn: tls: handshake error: remote error: tls: bad certificate
client_ip=203.0.113.45 cert_serial=0x3f1a... issuer=CN=redwood-intermediate
```
Li: that issuer is our intermediate. rotator-bot showed a rotation earlier but rotator marked region partial for apac. @rotator-bot paste run.
rotator-bot: rotation run apac-edge: rotated=15/18 status=partial errors=3 error_types=[KMS_DECRYPT_DENIED, CERT_CHAIN_MISMATCH]
audit-bot: recent IAM change detected: 2026-03-24T22:50Z remove binding arn:aws:iam::123456:role/rotator-legacy from kms apac keys (change=iam-prune-55)
Tess: so rotator couldn't unwrap some private material; plus CDN still serving old intermediate chain -> certs and chain mismatch. that explains the rejects.
Omar: where did the CDN old chain come from? CF cache or origin?
Li: looking at cdn logs — origin rotated to new leaf certs but left stale cached intermediates for a subset of edge nodes. cache TTL was long and cache invalidation didn't run during rotator retry.
Tess: root cause chain: automated IAM pruning removed rotator-legacy access to some APAC keys, the rotator then reissued certs partly (some certs created without key material), and CDN cached old intermediate chain causing a mix-match -> clients saw certs whose chain didn't validate with presented key.
Omar: mitigation steps now?
Li: immediate: 1) re-grant decrypt to a scoped principal (rotator-legacy or rotator-v2) for apac keys; 2) purge CDN edge caches for intermediate cert path; 3) trigger full rotation retry.
Tess: I can purge CDN paths now (purge-id=purge-20260324-1). doing it.
rotator-bot: queued rotation retry once KMS policy detects change.
audit-bot: temporary policy change proposed: add statement AllowDecryptRotator for arn:aws:iam::123456:role/rotator-v2 on resources arn:aws:kms:apac-1:123456:key/* (condition Region=apac-1). change-id=kms-hotfix-224
Omar: applied policy patch at 23:58Z (change=kms-hotfix-224).
rotator-bot: rotation retry: apac-edge rotated=18/18 status=success.
Li: CDN purge completed. edge nodes report updated cert chain. client TLS handshakes returning to normal.
Tess: follow-ups: add a CI smoke test that validates rotator principal decrypts keys per region; add CDN invalidation step to rotator runbook; add audit rule: IAM prune that removes KMS decrypt bindings must alert sec-oncall and block until signed-off.
Omar: filed tasks: SEC-221 (alert for IAM prune->KMS impact), INFRA-430 (CI smoke + runbook change), CDN-128 (shorter TTL for intermediate cert path).
Li: will add timeline and artifacts to incident page. INC-2026-04012 created.
Tess: thanks team. closing thread unless we see replays. :white_check_mark:
